metadata.name: SageMaker endpoint 5xx errors
metadata.description: A SageMaker endpoint reported invocation 5xx errors.

query.base: FROM metrics-aws_sagemaker.metrics-* | WHERE aws_sagemaker.metrics.namespace == "AWS/SageMaker" | STATS errors = SUM(aws_sagemaker.metrics.invocation_5xx_errors) BY aws_sagemaker.endpoint.name

data.content: Check endpoint status is InService and read /aws/sagemaker/Endpoints/{name}. Compare invocation 4xx, 5xx, and model errors on the endpoint. Scale the instance count if the container is failing under load.
